description:
About our brand and products:
Noa Lume is a minimal, soft-luxury jewelry brand that creates timeless pieces with meaningful symbols. Every design is crafted to remind women of their inner power, elegance and the journey they are growing into. Our jewelry is refined, intentional and created to blend beauty with deeper meaning.

What makes us different:
We combine high-quality materials with storytelling. Each piece represents self-expression, confidence and femininity. Our aesthetic is warm, minimal, soft and luxurious — designed for women who value simplicity, elegance and emotional connection.

How affiliates can earn:
Creators earn commissions on every sale made through their personal link or discount code. Depending on their tier, creators receive a total benefit of 15% or 30%, which they can divide themselves into a follower discount and a commission percentage (for example: 20% off + 10% commission or 10% off + 20% commission). Payments are made monthly once the €50 threshold is reached.

How to promote us:
Creators can share content such as close-up product shots, styling videos, unboxings, lifestyle clips, ring/ear stacking, GRWM videos or ASMR-style TikToks. We value soft beige tones, minimal aesthetics, and warm luxury visuals that match the Noa Lume identity.

Other information:
Creators receive a curated jewelry package, their own personal discount code, a trackable link, access to a full dashboard and brand assets. We expect at least one TikTok video per product received. High-performing creators can unlock bonuses, early access and additional incentives.
payout_period: Payouts are processed in the first week of every month once the €50 minimum threshold has been reached.
